function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Using only the evidence returned by the benchmark tools you can access, research and reconstruct the Pandora Papers public reporting concerning King Abdullah II of Jordan's alleged offshore property network. Return a structured evidence dossier, citing exclusively the exact source IDs supplied by the benchmark evidence. Identify only entities, people, advisers, intermediaries, jurisdictions, shell companies, ownership or control relationships, other relationship types, luxury real-estate locations, and dates that are directly supported. For every item, distinguish verified fact, reported allegation, source assessment, inference, and unresolved uncertainty. Map the documented or alleged connections among the actors and entities, including which companies owned or controlled which properties and how advisers or intermediaries are linked, but do not infer missing links. Note contradictions, denials, gaps, and limitations in the evidence. Preserve the benchmark source IDs exactly and provide enough quoted or paraphrased evidence for a final readable Markdown report plus a fenced JSON object with arrays named findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions; each finding must have question, answer, supporting_entities, source_references; each claim must have claim and source_references; each reasoning step must have id, conclusion, premise_entities, premise_relations; each contradiction must have contradiction_id, description, source_references."}
function.name: ConductResearch
